questions.question: Why is the endpoint term needed and why is slope weighting correct?
questions.answer: The narrow-band width is inversely proportional to slope, so multiplying by slope makes one unit per crossing. A field already active at zero has no upward crossing inside the track, adding an indicator with expectation Q(q).
